# WebSocket triggers

## Client: connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to another program over a WebSocket (an open line two programs use to chat quickly).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Client** | Only run for the WebSocket client with this name (a connection Cuebot makes to another program). Leave empty for any client. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clientName%` | The client's name |
| `%url%` | The address it connects to |

<small>Type id: `websocket.clientOpen`</small>

## Client: disconnected

Runs when Cuebot's WebSocket connection to another program ends.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Client** | Only run for the WebSocket client with this name (a connection Cuebot makes to another program). Leave empty for any client. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clientName%` | The client's name |
| `%url%` | The address it connects to |
| `%reason%` | Why it ended: disconnected (on purpose) or closed (by the other side) |

<small>Type id: `websocket.clientClose`</small>

## Client: message

Runs when the other program, which Cuebot is connected to over a WebSocket, sends Cuebot a message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Client** | Only run for the WebSocket client with this name (a connection Cuebot makes to another program). Leave empty for any client. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%clientName%` | The client's name |
| `%url%` | The address it connects to |
| `%message%` | The text it sent |

<small>Type id: `websocket.clientMessage`</small>

## Custom server: connection closed

Runs when a program disconnects from one of your own WebSocket servers.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Server** | Only run for the WebSocket server with this name (a server you made in Cuebot that other programs can connect to). Leave empty for any server. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%serverName%` | The server's name |
| `%sessionId%` | Which connected program this is |
| `%remote%` | Where the program connected from |

<small>Type id: `websocket.serverClose`</small>

## Custom server: connection opened

Runs when another program connects to one of your own WebSocket servers. A WebSocket is an open line two programs use to chat quickly.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Server** | Only run for the WebSocket server with this name (a server you made in Cuebot that other programs can connect to). Leave empty for any server. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%serverName%` | The server's name |
| `%sessionId%` | Which connected program this is |
| `%remote%` | Where the program connected from |

<small>Type id: `websocket.serverOpen`</small>

## Custom server: message

Runs when a program connected to your own WebSocket server sends Cuebot a message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Server** | Only run for the WebSocket server with this name (a server you made in Cuebot that other programs can connect to). Leave empty for any server. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%serverName%` | The server's name |
| `%sessionId%` | Which connected program this is |
| `%remote%` | Where the program connected from |
| `%message%` | The text it sent |

<small>Type id: `websocket.serverMessage`</small>
